scope: Links with a picture inside now read and open correctly on web pages.

topics.title: Pictures with useless names are skipped
details: Some pictures are named Placeholder, image, or a file name. Voice Companion no longer reads these names.
This works the same in Chrome and in the built-in browser.

topics.title: Links in lists
details: When a list item is a link, Down Arrow now says Link before its name.
Enter now opens the link. Before, Enter did nothing on some sites, such as Mystic Access Downloads.
